messages:
elena.cs: Heads-up 1: Novara accepted the Preview invite and wants a tight 30-day adoption plan. They care about search relevance and cost.

lia.ps: Nice. Do we know which deployment theyll use? Hosted or Dedicated?

elena.cs: Hosted for first 2 weeks, then likely Dedicated if cost/latency looks good. Theyre procurement-sensitive so renewal risk = medium-high.

tom.se: I'll take the kickoff demo. Can we split the 30-day plan into weekly milestones? e.g., week0 baseline, week1 prototypes, week2 integration, week3 metrics + polish.

rahul.eng: Agree. From infra side: need to reserve a Dedicated slot for the final week for load tests. Also request 3 sample payloads to estimate token budget.

elena.cs: Action items: @tom.se demo + templates, @lia.ps prompt + eval set, @rahul.eng reserve Dedicated slot. I'll send calendar invite.

lia.ps: For eval set: recommend 200 queries across 4 intents, include edge cases for vendor names and numeric data. I'll assemble and anonymize. ETA: EOD Tue.

tom.se: Demo plan: 15min walkthrough, 20min hands-on with their payloads, 10min Q&A. Will show: fallback routing, top-k rerank, and how to pin model versions.

elena.cs: Customer asked for expected token spend estimate. Lia, can you include token counts per intent?

lia.ps: Yes. Rough estimates attached in the doc I'll post after this thread. Example: search-rewrite avg 120 tokens, chat summary avg 80 tokens.

rahul.eng: Reserved a Dedicated test node for week3 (small GPU). Also enabled verbose request logs for preview seats. Need service account email to grant logs access.

elena.cs: Novara contact: amir@novara.io. I'll request SA email and ask them to run this quick health check before the call:

```
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" https://preview.api.redwood.ai/v1/health | jq
```

elena.cs: Also asking for 3 anonymized payload examples and a short list of KPIs (precision@5, avg latency, cost per 1k tokens).

tom.se: Should we suggest a success threshold? Maybe precision@5 >= 0.6 and p95 latency < 350ms on hosted. That gives procurement something measurable.

elena.cs: Good idea. I'll propose that. If theyre comfortable we'll include an escalation path to Dedicated with SLA.

lia.ps: One more: recommend using quantized 13B model for prototype to balance cost and latency. Note this in the setup doc.

calendar-bot: Meeting scheduled: Novara Preview Kickoff  Thu 2025-03-20 09:00 EDT  zoom.us/j/987654321 :calendar:

elena.cs: Sent calendar invite and prep note to Amir. Included a short checklist and asked for payloads + SA email.

rahul.eng: I'll run an automated smoke on the preview host tomorrow and post results here. If any errors, I'll open a support ticket with eng-oncall.

tom.se: I'll prepare a short workbook for the customer to track adoption metrics and share a template.

elena.cs: Great. We'll reconvene 24h before the call to confirm. Posting weekly milestone doc here once lia finishes the eval set. :rocket:
